role: boss hazard body: Thunder Swing's travelling ground wave, one whole wave life, carried along the floor by the game
style: stylized anime combat, dark storm stage, one red element
dominant_shape: a travelling front of rearing bolts racing along the floor, leaving a cooling scorched wake

beats.name: birth
beats.expect: A tall white-cored bolt and a red bloom tear out of the floor at the caster: the brightest moment

beats.name: travel
beats.expect: The front with a rearing bolt is about 1.7 m toward the target, a red scorched streak and arcs behind it

beats.name: travel
beats.expect: The front is most of the way to the target and slowing; the wake behind it cools

beats.name: arrives
beats.expect: The front has stopped at the target feet; last bolts there, nothing past the target

beats.name: collapse
beats.expect: A scorch mark under the target cooling to deep red, last embers

acceptance: The front visibly travels from the caster toward the target
The wake stays where the front passed and cools, so the path draws itself
The front is hotter and taller than the wake
The wave thins out over f66-f90 instead of switching off
avoid: A symmetric blob that reads as standing still
A solid glowing tube along the floor
Bolts tall enough to read as a sky strike
